question: Can a compact, interpretable set of canonical V1 breakout-formation lineages be constructed reproducibly without post-entry outcomes?
mechanism: The original V1 breakout event may arrive through different combinations of base repair/compression and price acceptance above its objective prior-60 close reference. These structures are defined without asserting which one will perform better.

population.identity_source: accepted 399 unique completed-cycle entry identities only; source columns are projected with pandas usecols
population.qualification: Population is conditioned on accepted completed V1 entries and is bounded PIT-B, not strict archival PIT-A. Completion does not enter feature values or lineage assignment.

canonical_event.reference: maximum adjusted-coordinate close over t-60..t-1, converted exactly to signal-session raw-price coordinates
canonical_event.predicate: signal adjusted close strictly exceeds the prior-60 close reference

daily_representation.history: 80 contiguous critical-valid sessions ending on signal t with every action-coordinate step valid
daily_representation.base_window: t-20..t-1, divided into fixed first and last ten-session halves
daily_representation.support_shift20: log(min adjusted low in last ten / min adjusted low in first ten)
daily_representation.resistance_shift20: log(max adjusted high in last ten / max adjusted high in first ten), descriptive only
daily_representation.range_contraction20: log(first-ten normalized range width / last-ten normalized range width)
daily_representation.volatility_contraction20: sample standard deviation of first-half action-safe log returns minus last-half standard deviation
daily_representation.downside_amount_contraction20: first-half fraction of amount on negative-return sessions minus last-half fraction, descriptive only
daily_representation.reference_context: fixed 2% prior-close test count, sessions since latest reference close, and t-1 distance from reference are descriptive only

intraday_representation.primary_grid: 240 continuous one-minute bars; 09:30 auction is audited but excluded from primary path
intraday_representation.first_cross: first continuous bar with high strictly above the canonical raw reference
intraday_representation.time_above_reference: fraction of post-cross closes above reference plus half weight for exact equality
intraday_representation.below_reference_resilience: one minus post-cross fraction of closes at or below reference
intraday_representation.neighbor: the identical path construction on deterministic session-aware five-minute aggregation

lineage_algorithm.normalization: average-tie percentile ranks computed separately within each entry year
lineage_algorithm.base_repair_score: equal-weight mean of support_shift20, range_contraction20, and volatility_contraction20 percentile ranks
lineage_algorithm.breakout_acceptance_score: equal-weight mean of time_above_reference, close_reference_retention, and below_reference_resilience percentile ranks
lineage_algorithm.missing_data: no imputation; any missing critical feature fails the experiment
lineage_algorithm.lineage_meaning: neutral structure only; IDs contain no favorable or unfavorable outcome claim

construction_falsification.neighbor_base: remove volatility_contraction20 from the base score
construction_falsification.neighbor_intraday: replace one-minute reference path with exact five-minute aggregation
construction_falsification.temporal: all four lineages must occur in every entry year
construction_falsification.concentration: no lineage may dominate the population
construction_falsification.determinism: a second full run must produce byte-identical feature, assignment, audit, and freeze files

decision.FREEZE_LINEAGE: all construction, PIT, coverage, class-balance, temporal-presence, neighboring-assignment, and determinism gates pass
decision.REFINE: a clearly diagnosed outcome-blind definition or stability problem is repairable without any outcome access under a new identity
decision.REJECT: the fixed taxonomy collapses or is unstable and no minimum-sufficient outcome-blind refinement is justified
